```python
def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    initial_investment = 120.0  # millions of dollars
    gross_return_rate = 0.35
    management_fee_rate = 0.02
    incentive_fee_rate = 0.20
    hurdle_rate = 0.05

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    aum_end_year = initial_investment * (1 + gross_return_rate)
    gross_profit = initial_investment * gross_return_rate
    management_fee = aum_end_year * management_fee_rate
    hurdle_profit = initial_investment * hurdle_rate
    profit_above_hurdle_net_management_fee = (
        gross_profit - management_fee - hurdle_profit
    )
    incentive_fee = profit_above_hurdle_net_management_fee * incentive_fee_rate
    net_return = gross_profit - management_fee - incentive_fee
    answer = round(net_return, 2)

    # return answer in millions of dollars
    return answer
```
